title: RSE 12/12: Occultation local search (swe_lun_occult_when_loc + occult_when_loc)
description:
### Summary
Port `swe_lun_occult_when_loc` + its worker `occult_when_loc`: find the next/previous occultation of a planet/star by the Moon VISIBLE from `geopos`, with local contact times and circumstances. Final sub-task of the arc. Exposes `Ephemeris::lun_occult_when_loc` (`&self`).

Depends on **RSE 6** (`eclipse_how` attr fill), **RSE 8** (solar `when_loc` scaffolding this parallels), and **RSE 11** (occultation `where`/`when_glob` + body-radius helper).

### Files
- `src/eclipse.rs` — add `OccultLocal` result struct, `occult_when_loc`, `lun_occult_when_loc`.
- `src/context.rs` — `pub fn lun_occult_when_loc(&self, tjd_start, body: Body, starname: Option<&str>, ifl: CalcFlags, geopos:[f64;3], backward: bool) -> Result<OccultLocal, Error>`.
- `src/lib.rs` — re-export `OccultLocal`.
- `tests/c-gen/gen_eclipse.c` — add key `occ_when_loc`; regenerate `eclipse.json`.
- `tests/golden/eclipse.rs` — add `#[test] occ_when_loc`.
- `docs/codebase-map.md` — final eclipse-module update (mark the arc complete in the map).

### Implementation steps
Read `docs/c-ref-occultation.md` §3 (`swe_lun_occult_when_loc` + `occult_when_loc`), cross-referencing `docs/c-ref-eclipse-solar.md` §6 (solar when_loc) and §4 (attr via eclipse_how).

1. **`OccultLocal`**: `tret[0..10]` per the §3 slot summary + `attr[]` (reuse `EclipseHow`/local-attr from RSE 6) + type bitmask.
2. **`swe_lun_occult_when_loc`** public wrapper (§3 "Public wrapper").
3. **`occult_when_loc`** worker (§3 "Worker"): topocentric setup (RSE 1 config-clone pattern), the search loop, contacts C1/C2/max/C3/C4 via `find_zero`. OCCULTATION-SPECIFIC forks flagged in the doc — port faithfully:
   - The fixed-star point-source branch collapses contacts 1/4 onto 2/3 (swecl.c:2696–2699).
   - The occultation-only `SE_ECL_OCC_BEG_DAYLIGHT`/`SE_ECL_OCC_END_DAYLIGHT` rise/set daylight logic (no solar equivalent).
   - The likely-dead `dtdiv` reassignment — replicate as-is, do NOT "fix" it.
   - `backward` flips direction.

### C reference
`docs/c-ref-occultation.md` §3; `docs/c-ref-eclipse-solar.md` §6, §4, §7.

### Golden tests
- **C harness** add key `occ_when_loc`: `geopos ∈ {(8.55,47.37,500)}`, `(ipl,starname) ∈ {(SE_VENUS,NULL), (-1,"Aldebaran")}`, `tjd_start ∈ {2451545.0}`, `backward ∈ {0,1}` → `swe_lun_occult_when_loc(tjd_start, ipl, starname, SEFLG_MOSEPH, geopos, tret, attr, backward, serr)`. Emit `{geopos, ipl, starname, tjd_start, backward, retval, tret:[0..10], attr:[0..11]}`. Regenerate `eclipse.json`.
- **Rust test** `#[test] occ_when_loc`: assert `tret`/`attr` via `assert_f64_eps(.., 1e-5)`; assert returned flags == `retval`. Star case needs the fixstar catalog loaded.
- `cargo test --test golden eclipse::occ_when_loc -- --nocapture` passes.

### Acceptance criteria
- `cargo build` + `cargo clippy --all-targets` clean.
- `cargo test --test golden eclipse::occ_when_loc -- --nocapture` passes (1e-5 day).
- Full golden suite green (`cargo test --test golden`).

### Escape hatch
If contact times fail > 1e-4 day after two attempts, STOP and report failing `(ipl/starname, geopos, backward)` + diverging slot. Read `swecl.c:2071–2764` directly (mind the occultation-specific forks in §3). Escalate to Opus after two attempts.
execution_record:
Implemented as planned per c-ref-occultation.md §3, following the same structure as eclipse_when_loc/lun_occult_when_glob. One divergence from the plan: the ref doc's phrasing for occult_when_loc's `iflag` setup ("iflag = SEFLG_TOPOCTR | ifl") was ambiguous enough to misread as matching solar's EQUATORIAL-augmented convention — read swecl.c:2441-2443 directly to confirm it deliberately omits SEFLG_EQUATORIAL (harmless for the dot-product angle math, but a real literal divergence worth flagging). Also read swecl.c:2742-2772 directly for the rise/set/daylight block (§3 step 12) since the ref doc's prose didn't specify the exact anchor offsets (occulted-body rise/set uses tret[1]-0.1, not solar's -0.001) or the retc>=0 chaining/no-DISC_BOTTOM-for-Sun details.

First golden test run failed on the Aldebaran (star) cases: attr.azimuth off by ~4e-3 degrees, tret[0..4] off by ~0.3-0.55 sec (Venus/planet cases passed exactly). Root cause: eclipse_how/occult_when_loc's star branch routes through Ephemeris::fixstar2, which only ever read self.config -- it had no way to receive the per-call topo_config override this module (and every other topocentric caller) builds, so SEFLG_TOPOCTR silently became a no-op for fixed stars (config.topographic was None on the base Ephemeris). This was a pre-existing, documented gap (riseset.rs has the same note) with zero prior golden coverage; occ_when_loc is the first test to exercise topocentric eclipse_how for a star. Fixed by adding Ephemeris::fixstar2_with_config (mirrors calc_with_config) and threading an explicit &EphemerisConfig through calc_fixstar/calc_fixstar_moshier/_sweph/_jpl, adding the topocentric observer offset (calc::topo_offset, widened to pub(crate)) to xobs/xobs_dt per docs/c-ref-fixstar.md step 6. After the fix all 4 occ_when_loc cases match C within 1e-7 (well under the 1e-5 day/1e-5 degree tolerances). Full golden suite (104 tests) and cargo clippy --all-targets both clean; no regressions.
